newsitem.title: USA: GoodMark CEO sees positive net comparisons.
newsitem.headline: GoodMark CEO sees positive net comparisons.

text.p: GoodMark Foods Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Ron Doggett said Tuesday he expects positive quarterly comparisons for the balance of the 1997 fiscal year, propelled by new products and an aggressive marketing campaign.
Doggett's positive outlook came on the day the company released results for the first quarter that he described as "slightly below our expectations."

He said he expects promotional, advertising and merchandising programs, coupled with new products, will allow the company to "regain momentum" and lead to "double-digit revenue growth from our branded snacks business."
Second-quarter margins will be affected by gradual increases in meat costs and from minor losses incurred from a power outage related to Hurricane Fran, the company said.
However, those setbacks may be offset somewhat by an improved mix of products and other measures, the company said.
"Overall, we expect positive quarterly comparisons for the balance of fiscal 1997 and a record year," Doggett said in a statement.
